# Genre Cut Style Guide: Action
- Split at the impact, not through it. One continuous motion stays in one Cut; let the impact open the next Cut as its first frame, which is where the emphasis lands.
- Open on a master shot that carries the spatial relationship, then move into detail Cuts. It counts as an Establishing Shot only where the Scene meets one of the four conditions.
- Carry the urgency in short, hard descriptions. A Cut cannot go under 3 seconds, so the pace comes from what is inside the frame rather than from cutting shorter.
